fuse_conv_bn: fuse a Conv2d layer with BatchNorm2d for quantization aware training or eval mode
fuse_conv_bn_relu: fuse a Conv2d layer with BatchNorm2d and ReLU for quantization aware training or eval mode
fuse_linear_bn: fuse a Linear layer with BatchNorm1d for quantization aware training or eval mode
fuse_convtranspose_bn: fuse a ConvTranspose2d layer with BatchNorm2d in eval mode
get_fuser_method: get the fuser method for a given tuple of module types from the default or custom mapping
